effect.name: GM Topography
effect.desc: A proper topographic map built from the layer. Luminance becomes elevation, elevation is cut into coloured bands through a three-stop terrain palette, every band boundary is drawn as a contour line, and every Nth line is drawn heavier as an index contour the way a real survey map does. A hillshade pass from an adjustable sun sits underneath the lines so the terrain reads as relief rather than as flat colour. Band count, band smoothing, contour widths, index interval, height scale and a pre-blur are all separate controls. Layer space throughout.
